loyalty.page_subtitle: Okohi integration — reward your customers on every trip
loyalty.connect_only_admin: Only the administrator can connect Okohi to Tiketi.
loyalty.enter_code_hint: Enter the Okohi code to activate loyalty
loyalty.earning_step_hint: This rule is applied by Okohi when a Tiketi ticket is validated.
loyalty.mode_unavailable_hint: First define the Points or Visits mode in Okohi, then reload this page.
loyalty.visits_mode_hint: Tiketi configures the threshold and the number of visits credited.
loyalty.points_mode_hint: Tiketi configures how points are calculated.
loyalty.points_mode_readonly_hint: The ticket amount is split into brackets to credit points.
loyalty.zero_rule_hint: Enter 0 to apply the rule to any purchase.
loyalty.tranche_calculation_hint: The ticket amount is split into brackets to calculate points.
loyalty.connection_steps: In Okohi: Edit establishment → API Integration → Partner Apps → Connect.
loyalty.connect_step_1: In the Okohi app, go to Edit establishment → API Integration → Partner Apps and click Connect next to Tiketi.
loyalty.connect_step_2: Okohi generates a 4-digit code valid for 24h. Copy it.
loyalty.connect_step_3: Enter the code in the form and click Connect.
loyalty.connect_step_4: The integration is active. The QR code on every printed ticket lets the customer scan and earn points automatically.
loyalty.rewards_header_hint: Define how many points or visits entitle customers to each benefit
loyalty.no_rewards_hint: Create your first reward to start building loyalty
loyalty.no_transactions_hint: Transactions will appear here as soon as customers scan their QR codes
loyalty.total_transactions: {total} transaction in total | {total} transactions in total
loyalty.help_step_1: Tiketi sells and prints the ticket. Its QR code contains the information needed for loyalty.
loyalty.help_step_2: The customer scans the QR code in Okohi. Okohi then asks Tiketi to verify the ticket.
loyalty.help_step_3: Tiketi confirms the ticket. Okohi applies the earning rule defined for the company.
loyalty.help_step_4: The customer receives points or a visit. They can then exchange them for rewards from the catalog.
loyalty.disconnect_message: QR codes on upcoming tickets will no longer be linked to Okohi. Already printed tickets are not affected.
loyalty.new_reward_modal_hint: Define what the customer spends and what they receive
loyalty.saved_in_okohi: This reward will be saved in Okohi
loyalty.saved_in_okohi_hint: Choose the benefit the customer receives, then the cost deducted from their loyalty balance.
loyalty.fixed_amount_hint: Amount deducted from the ticket price.
loyalty.free_ticket_benefit_hint: No amount to enter: Okohi automatically applies 100% coverage.
loyalty.stock_hint: Each claim consumes one unit. Leave empty for unlimited.
loyalty.valid_until_hint: Leave empty if the reward never expires.
loyalty.delete_reward_message: {title} will be removed from the Okohi catalog. This action is irreversible.
